claim: In the AWS decision guide comparison table, the use case of Fargate is long-running, containerized applications, while the use case of Lambda is short-duration, event-driven tasks.
question: In the AWS Fargate-or-Lambda comparison, which use case belongs to Fargate and which to Lambda?

qualifiers.scope: AWS Fargate compared with AWS Lambda

evidence.quote: |  Use case  |  Long-running, containerized applications  |  Short-duration, event-driven tasks (or workflows up to 1 year with durable functions)  |
